# benchmark-rollback-recovery

> Does the agent notice its own bad action, repair it and say so?

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-rollback-recovery
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-rollback-recovery
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-rollback-recovery

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `createRollbackBenchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-rollback-recovery/api` exports the fetch-style `handler` and `createApiHandler`. `benchmark-rollback-recovery/mcp` exports MCP builders. Alternate task files are accepted via the `tasks` option (CLI `--tasks`, SDK `tasks`, `RRB_TASKS_FILE` for the API).

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
